title: Recovered in Translation: Efficient Pipeline for Automated Translation of Benchmarks and Datasets
reasoning: The paper focuses on an automated translation framework for benchmarks and datasets. Its primary research goal is improving translation quality and reducing errors like semantic drift and context loss. While it includes an Ethics Statement and translates benchmarks like MMLU (which contains a sub-category on ethics), the core research is not focused on evaluating religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
